description: Skip the mic noise preprocessing in the rmm audio loop: nop the bl speex_preprocess_run at vaddr 0x36e64. AAC encoding (HI_MPI_AENC_SendFrame) still runs, so audio frames keep flowing to mp4record. The call's return value is unused (r3 is reloaded at 0x36e68).
source_reference: docs/research/rmm.md, Ways to modify rmm, patch A
